description: Land Acquisition - Wagollakada, Horowpothana D/S Division, Anuradhapura District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired for public purpose, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, extents, and location details. The content focuses solely on land/property matters without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any other category. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
